recipes.title: White Bean Turkey Chili

source.name: ENGLISH - Boston.gov
source.location: Page 33, shared by Karen M. Olevitz & Joseph P. Tynan

steps: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or stockpot over medium-high heat.
Add chopped sweet onion and minced garlic; sauté for 3 to 4 minutes until onions become soft and translucent.
Add ground turkey breast, breaking it apart with a wooden spoon, and cook until browned and no longer pink (about 6 to 8 minutes).
Pour in the two jars of salsa verde and the chicken broth, stirring well to combine.
Add the drained cannellini beans, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the chili to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and let simmer gently for 20 to 25 minutes to blend flavors.
Ladle into warm bowls and serve hot with desired garnishes like fresh cilantro, diced avocado, or tortilla chips.
recipes.swaps: Great Northern beans or navy beans can replace cannellini beans; ground chicken can replace ground turkey.
recipes.notes: Equipment: Large Dutch oven or heavy stockpot, wooden spoon. Hearty, high-protein white bean dinner.
